text: The ASEAN+3 Climate Disaster Risk Financing Collaboration, centered on the Southeast Asia Disaster Risk Insurance Facility (SEADRIF), is a regional risk financing platform designed to provide pre-arranged finance and insurance for climate and disaster shocks. It operates under the ASEAN+3 political umbrella, offering rapid, rules-based insurance disbursements and capacity-building across the region. SEADRIF aims to enhance fiscal resilience and regional financial stability through its integration with ASEAN+3's broader disaster risk finance architecture.
